subject.title: feat(minimax): route /fast to MiniMax's faster paid lanes with correct pricing

question: Should the existing `/fast` setting opt MiniMax-M3 into its higher-cost priority lane, or should M3 remain unchanged as specified by the canonical follow-up?
rationale: Current behavior, the canonical issue, and the competing implementation preserve M3, while this PR intentionally changes existing fast-mode semantics and spend; code review cannot choose that product contract.

options.title: Keep M3 unchanged
options.body: Land only the M2.7 highspeed accounting repair and handle any future M3 priority opt-in through an explicitly approved provider contract.

options.title: Adopt M3 priority
options.body: Approve `/fast` as the M3 paid-priority opt-in, align the canonical issue and competing PR, and require tier-aware billing plus live upgrade proof.

options.title: Add an explicit control
options.body: Preserve current `/fast` behavior and introduce a separate provider-owned M3 priority setting only if maintainers accept the additional configuration surface.

recommendation.title: Keep M3 unchanged
recommendation.body: Land only the M2.7 highspeed accounting repair and handle any future M3 priority opt-in through an explicitly approved provider contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies steipete as the author of the current MiniMax-M3 provider baseline and therefore the strongest owner for its fast-mode contract.
